import_config: import a configuration dictionary into the open-webui application state
export_config: export the current open-webui application configuration as a dictionary
verify_tool_servers: verify a tool server connection and retrieve its tool specs for MCP or OpenAPI servers
set_connections_config: set direct connections and base models cache settings for the open-webui application
set_code_execution_config: configure code execution and code interpreter settings including Jupyter server parameters
